proposed_fix.description: Gated horizontal scale-out and conditional rolling restart to reset exhausted socket connection pools.

Upon approval, execute a horizontal scale-out of productcatalogservice replicas by 50% to distribute socket load.
If latency persists, await human approval to trigger a rolling restart of productcatalogservice pods to reset connection pools.
preconditions: Confirm the productcatalogservice_socket metric spike correlates with connection pool exhaustion or downstream blocking.
Verify cluster autoscaling limits permit the proposed replica increase.
Ensure no active deployments, maintenance windows, or dependent service outages are in progress.
proposed_fix.rollback: Immediately scale down replicas to the original count and cancel the rolling restart if latency does not improve or if error rates increase.
